# apipbx_server_settings (Resource)

The server's own settings, kept in its database (so a backup holds them) and applied to Asterisk's configuration files: a singleton, needs a platform key. Only the attributes you set are sent; the others keep the server's value and are read back. A change to a port, TLS or the manager login restarts Asterisk and apipbxd. Destroying this resource leaves the settings as they are. Import with "settings".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ami_bind` (String) The manager's listen address.
- `ami_port` (Number) The manager's listen port.
- `ami_secret` (String, Sensitive) The manager secret (8-128 characters, no spaces or ; = \). Write-only: the server never returns it, so a change made elsewhere is not detected.
- `ami_user` (String) The Asterisk manager login apipbxd uses to reload Asterisk. Changing it restarts Asterisk and apipbxd.
- `call_recordings_dir` (String) Where call recordings are written.
- `db_user` (String) The database user Asterisk connects as.
- `external_ip` (String) The public IP when behind NAT; empty = none.
- `iax_port` (Number) The IAX2 UDP port.
- `local_net` (String) The local network CIDR, with external_ip.
- `mail_cmd` (String) The command voicemail emails are piped to.
- `media_url` (String) Where Asterisk fetches recordings from (apipbxd's /media).
- `odbc_dsn` (String) The ODBC data source Asterisk reads the database through (default apipbx).
- `rtp_end` (Number) The last audio (RTP) port.
- `rtp_start` (Number) The first audio (RTP) port.
- `sip_port` (Number) The SIP UDP port.
- `tls_cert` (String) The TLS certificate file (PEM, full chain) on the server; with tls_key it switches on SIP over TLS and WebRTC.
- `tls_key` (String) The TLS key file (PEM) on the server.
- `tls_only` (Boolean) Accept no plain SIP at all (needs a certificate).
- `tls_port` (Number) The SIP over TLS port.
- `voicemail_from` (String) The From address of voicemail emails.
- `voicemail_max_secs` (Number) A voicemail message ends at this length (default 180).
- `voicemail_max_silence` (Number) The recording stops after this many seconds of silence (default 5); the caller can always end it with #.
- `voicemail_min_secs` (Number) A voicemail message shorter than this many seconds is thrown away (default 1).
- `wss_port` (Number) The secure WebSocket (WebRTC) port; -1 leaves WebRTC off.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
